scientific_integrity: An exact executable verifier accompanies the complete algebraic proof. Finite-field computations are supporting checks, not proofs over algebraic closures.
scientific_limitations: Specific integral plane-cubic pencil only. Characteristic-three cusp of the zero parameter is prior knowledge; Kodaira fibers and unique classification of all small-characteristic pencils are not claimed. Residual unindexed-literature priority risk.
title: Exceptional-characteristic arithmetic of the one-base-point cubic pencil
